title: Mobile Experience
meta: Make your store easier to browse and buy from on a phone: menus, buttons, forms and speed. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: A mobile experience shoppers enjoy using
overview: Most visitors reach your store on a phone, so we use your store on real phone sizes and fix what gets in the way. Menus, search, filters, product images, buttons and forms are checked for thumb reach, text size and spacing. We fix layout problems, trim heavy images and move the buy button where a thumb expects it. You receive screenshots from before and after, so the changes are easy to see.

faq: Which phones do you test on?
We check common iPhone and Android screen sizes using device views and real devices where we have them. Send us the models your customers use most and we will include them.
Will desktop look the same afterward?
Yes. We write mobile-only changes so your desktop layout stays as it is, unless you ask us to change both. We confirm that with screenshots.
Do you rebuild my theme for mobile?
No. We fix and tune the theme you have. If the theme is the problem, we say so and suggest a cleaner option before spending your money.
Can you make a mobile app instead?
This service covers your mobile website only. A real app is a separate project, and we can quote it if you want to go that way.
